test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man can do a work in 6 days, whereas a woman can do the same work in 12 days. In how many days will a man and a woman working together be able to do the same work?
solution:
**Given**

A man complete a work in 6 days

A woman completes a work in 12 days

**Calculation**

let work done by man in 1 day = 1/6

and work done by woman in 1 day = 1/12

work done by man and woman in 1 day = (1/6) + (1/12)

⇒ (2 + 1)/12

⇒ 3/12

⇒ 1/4

**∴ Total work done by man and woman in 4 days**
